SELECT "g"."Id", "g"."CourseId", "g"."DirectionId", "g"."Name", "g"."ProjectId", "p"."Id", "p"."Name", "d"."Id", "d"."Name", "c"."Id", "c"."Name", "t"."Id", "t"."Phone", "t"."UserId", "t"."VkProfileLink", "t"."GroupsId", "t"."StudentsId"
FROM "Groups" AS "g"
INNER JOIN "Projects" AS "p" ON "g"."ProjectId" = "p"."Id"
INNER JOIN "Directions" AS "d" ON "g"."DirectionId" = "d"."Id"
INNER JOIN "Courses" AS "c" ON "g"."CourseId" = "c"."Id"
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT "s"."Id", "s"."Phone", "s"."UserId", "s"."VkProfileLink", "g0"."GroupsId", "g0"."StudentsId"
    FROM "group_students" AS "g0"
    INNER JOIN "Students" AS "s" ON "g0"."StudentsId" = "s"."Id"
) AS "t" ON "g"."Id" = "t"."GroupsId"
ORDER BY "g"."Id", "p"."Id", "d"."Id", "c"."Id", "t"."GroupsId", "t"."StudentsId"
